subject: [PATCH v2 2/4] mm: memcg: read root lruvec stats from the node counters

2026-11-10.patch_summary: This patch modifies the way the root memory cgroup (memcg) reads its LRU vector statistics from node counters. For most stats, it directly reads from the node counter to avoid flushing the entire system, which is expensive. However, for certain kernel memory stats and hugetlb, it still needs to read the rstat value because their node counters also count unaccounted memory. This change improves accuracy of root memcg statistics and reduces flush overhead.
